summary: Build school leadership skills in instructional management, improvement planning & staff performance. 5-day practical course. Enrol at TrainingCred.
lede: Education management and school leadership link teaching priorities with school planning and operations for principals, deputy heads, and education managers. The course builds practical skills in improvement planning, classroom observation and teacher feedback, interpreting student performance data, managing staff and budgets, and engaging families and governance stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who carry direct responsibility for school performance, instructional quality, or education program management — and who need structured frameworks to lead more effectively, not just manage more efficiently.
modules: Student Performance Data and Evidence-Based Decision-Making
Teacher Performance Management and Professional Development
School Financial Management and Resource Stewardship
Stakeholder Engagement, Communication, and School Culture
Strategic Leadership, Governance, and Institutional Sustainability
prerequisites: This course is designed for professionals at an intermediate level of school or education management experience. The following preparation is expected: Minimum experience: At least two years in a school leadership, department management, or education coordination role — or equivalent experience in an education system oversight function. Prior knowledge: Working familiarity with school operations, curriculum delivery, and staff management. No formal qualification in educational leadership is required. No technical prerequisites: No specialist software, coding, or advanced data analysis skills are required. Exercises use structured templates and sample datasets provided during the course. Pre-course preparation: Participants are encouraged to bring current school performance data, improvement plans, or staff development documents from their own institution to enrich workshop exercises. These are optional but strongly recommended.
